titles: Global Initiative Research facility
descriptions:
The Global SOC Research Facility will provide HMG with a continuous and timely threat assessment capability on a broad array of organized crime risks. Its objective is to analyse continuously threats and trends that have been agreed upon with UK Home Office in the course of quarterly check-in sessions as well as through ad-hoc requests.
